items.claim: Canvas layers the layer list doesn't name drop below the listed ones after a reorder
`ctx.trial.setZoom` ignores the zoom range and pivots about world (0,0)
After a reload, the first cross-redo check drops the redo both histories saved
An instrument history that mounts again while its trial stays open starts empty and is saved over the old one
A gesture on an `over` path that ends where it started leaves an empty undo step
items.note: `docs/unruled.md` ("Ruled 2026-11-10") says the lab's `over` keeps its steps, since the trial cannot take them back.

items.claim: Chrome context memo misses every render because `view2d` is a new object each time
A layer toggle or reorder records an undo step that undoes nothing
items.note: The step now records an op over the trial's layer order and visibility. A saved history leaves these steps out, since layer state isn't saved and a nameless op would have cut off the steps before it.

items.claim: Canvas layer not named in `layers.ids` jumps to the bottom of the stack after a reorder
An `alwaysOn` layer is drawn hidden when its visibility says false
The tool slot's chrome memo never holds because `setActiveTool` is a new closure each render
items.note: The same commit as the `view2d` fix, because both break the same memo.

items.claim: A saved trial history is marked restored before `enabled` is checked, so it is lost if the instrument gains `undo` later
The undo bindings and the loupe bindings were also new objects every render, so the chrome context memo still missed after the two reported fixes
